title: Verizon Delivers Strong Free Cash Flow Growth: Can Momentum Continue?
author: Zacks.Com
description: Verizon reported strong Q2 2026 free cash flow growth of 24.4% year-over-year to $6.4 billion, driven by improved profitability and margin expansion. The company raised its full-year 2026 free cash flow growth guidance to 9-10% from 7%. However, substantial capital investments in fiber expansion and wireless network upgrades remain a key challenge to sustaining growth momentum.

insights.sentiment_reasoning: Strong Q2 free cash flow growth of 24.4% YoY, EBITDA margin expansion from 37.1% to 40.1%, raised full-year guidance to 9-10% growth, and on track to achieve $9 billion in cost savings. However, sentiment is tempered by concerns about substantial ongoing capital needs.

title: Can AT&T's New Technology Offerings With Dallas Cowboys Lift Shares?
author: Zacks.Com
description: AT&T has extended its partnership with the Dallas Cowboys, introducing new AI, augmented reality, and connectivity technologies for the 2026 NFL season at AT&T Stadium. The stadium features 261 miles of fiber and nearly 1,000 antennas supporting new features like AI-generated hype videos, AR experiences, and high-priority network access. However, AT&T shares have underperformed the industry by 109.7% over the past year, and the company faces intense competition from Verizon and T-Mobile in advancing network and AI capabilities.

insights.sentiment_reasoning: While AT&T is expanding technology offerings and maintaining its Cowboys partnership, the company's stock has significantly underperformed the industry (down 12.2% vs. industry up 97.5% over the past year). The partnership demonstrates innovation but appears insufficient to drive meaningful share appreciation. The company carries a Zacks Rank #3 (Hold) rating.

title: Is Verizon the Year's Best Telecom Stock?
author: Catie Hogan
description: Verizon Communications has undergone a significant turnaround in 2026 under new CEO Dan Schulman, beating quarterly expectations and achieving 184,000 postpaid net phone additions. The company's acquisition of Frontier Communications boosted fiber broadband connections by 43% year-over-year, while targeting $5 billion in cost cuts. Verizon's stock has risen over 25% this year with expanding EBITDA and margins, positioning it as a potential top-performing telecom stock compared to competitors T-Mobile and AT&T.

insights.sentiment_reasoning: Strong operational turnaround under new CEO with beating quarterly expectations, significant postpaid phone additions reversal, successful Frontier acquisition boosting fiber broadband by 43%, aggressive cost-cutting targets, expanding EBITDA and margins, 25%+ stock price increase in 2026, and attractive dividend yield of 5.78%.

title: AT&T Teams Up With LifeMD for Virtual Health Care: Can it Aid Shares?
author: Zacks.Com
description: AT&T has partnered with LifeMD to offer complimentary virtual healthcare and pharmacy services to eligible wireless and fiber customers, waiving the $19 monthly membership fee. The benefit initially covers 29 million customers in 11 states with nationwide expansion expected in January 2027. AT&T faces competition from Verizon and T-Mobile, which are also advancing healthcare technology offerings. AT&T shares have underperformed the industry over the past year, currently holding a Zacks Rank #3 (Hold) rating.

insights.sentiment_reasoning: While the LifeMD partnership expands customer benefits and supports engagement, AT&T shares have underperformed significantly (down 8.9% over the past year vs. industry growth of 94.3%), and the company carries a Hold rating. The initiative is positive but insufficient to offset broader market underperformance.

title: Nokia accelerates AI-RAN adoption as global operators embrace AI-native network evolution on NVIDIA platforms
author: Nokia Press Office
description: Nokia announced expanding global momentum for AI-RAN technology, with major telecom operators across multiple regions advancing from evaluation to live field trials. The AI-RAN platform has delivered over 20% improvements in spectral efficiency, with further gains planned through 2028. The partnership with NVIDIA and growing operator ecosystem demonstrates AI-RAN's transition from research concept to commercial deployment for 5G and 6G networks.

insights.sentiment_reasoning: Nokia is leading AI-RAN commercialization with expanding global operator partnerships, demonstrated 20% spectral efficiency improvements, and a clear roadmap for continued innovation through 2028. The company is positioning itself as the industry leader in AI-native network platforms.

NVIDIA's Aerial RAN Computer is integral to Nokia's AI-RAN platform deployment across multiple global operators. The partnership positions NVIDIA as a critical infrastructure provider for the emerging AI-native telecom ecosystem.
Chunghwa Telecom is engaged in AI-RAN trials with Nokia, demonstrating commitment to AI-native network evolution and positioning for competitive advantage in 5G/6G deployment.
